stories.title: Tool Allowlist Schema and Registry Definition
stories.description: Define the allowlist registry structure mapping tool names to their corresponding Pydantic schemas and callable handlers, ensuring a single source of truth for permitted tools.

stories.title: Core Tool Routing Execution Loop
stories.description: Implement the core routing loop that parses Anthropic tool_use blocks, validates inputs via Pydantic models, dispatches to the correct service, and returns structured responses.

stories.title: FastAPI Integration for Tool Dispatch
stories.description: Integrate the tool router into the FastAPI request lifecycle, ensuring chat requests invoke the routing system and correctly pass conversation history and tool responses.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Tool Router
stories.description: Create comprehensive tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation, successful dispatch, error handling, and end-to-end tool invocation flows.
